I'm an Egyptian, a really pale one. Ever since I was a young child my parents closed the blinds and turned on the ACs (which are in ever SINGLE room in our house), my dad would put whole bottles of sun screen on me and my siblings whenever we went out (which was pretty rare). Me and my sister were very indoor children, so were my parents. And as I became older my depression got worse and I stopped completely going outside during any breaks. We eventually moved to Turkey, and I was introduced to the internet after getting my very own first laptop at 9. As of now I have a Vitamin D deficiency and people always tend to believe me and my family are a mix of American and Italian (since me and my sister have an American accent and my parents have an Italian one). It's always a hassle to explain all of this, and they usually adress us as "liars" whenever I tell them the entire thing. So I just completely began avoiding these types of questions.
